---
title: "Running Scenarios"
---

`run_scenarios` drives the whole pipeline from a list of settings and campaigns and returns one
row for each. It is exported from `estimint` but runs both packages, and nothing is imported
from `stateMINT` directly. The pages that follow build a `Scenario`, run a grid of campaigns
against a shared baseline, and compare and export the trajectories and cases that come back.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Running scenarios](run-scenarios.qmd) — `Scenario`, `EirTarget`, and the returned columns.
- [A list of scenarios](scenario-grid.qmd) — five campaigns against one baseline.
- [Trajectories and cases](comparing.qmd) — prevalence, clinical incidence, and cases averted.
- [Exporting results](exporting.qmd) — CSV, and a tidy table R can read.
:::
